tier1.text: Like tiny sewage treatment plants, peroxisomes make harmful toxins safe. In liver cells, for example, they make alcohol harmless. Many of their reactions give off toxic hydrogen peroxide, which they safely break down into oxygen and water. Each peroxisome is small and round, with a single membrane around it.

quotes.quote: Many of these oxidation reactions release hydrogen peroxide, H2O2, which would be damaging to cells; however, when these reactions are confined to peroxisomes, enzymes safely break down the H2O2 into oxygen and water.
quotes.citation: Clark MA, Douglas M, Choi J (2018). Biology 2e. OpenStax.

quotes.quote: Peroxisomes are small, round organelles enclosed by single membranes.

figures.title: Peroxisome
figures.caption: Peroxisomes are membrane-bound organelles that contain an abundance of enzymes for detoxifying harmful substances and lipid metabolism.
figures.alt: This diagram shows a peroxisome, which is a vesicular structure with a lipid bilayer on the outside and a crystalline core on the inside.
